title: Portugal, Spain and Switzerland reach World Cup last 16
facts: Spain defeated Austria 3-0 in a knockout match on July 2, 2026, to advance to the World Cup last-16. [cite: 461]
Mikel Oyarzabal scored two goals for Spain during their 3-0 victory against Austria. [cite: 461]
Substitute Gonçalo Ramos scored a headed goal in the fourth minute of stoppage time to give Portugal a victory over Croatia. [cite: 463, 464]
Rafael Leao provided the pass that led to Gonçalo Ramos's stoppage-time goal for Portugal against Croatia. [cite: 464]
A late goal by Croatia's Josko Gvardiol was disallowed for offside during their match against Portugal. [cite: 465]
Cristiano Ronaldo scored a penalty goal to cancel out Ivan Perisic's opener in the match between Portugal and Croatia. [cite: 467]
Cristiano Ronaldo's penalty against Croatia was his first ever goal in the knockout phase of the World Cup. [cite: 468]
Portugal is scheduled to face Spain in Dallas on Monday in the next round of the World Cup. [cite: 468]
Switzerland eliminated Algeria from the World Cup with a 2-0 victory on Thursday. [cite: 469]
Breel Embolo scored the first goal for Switzerland against Algeria after a cross from Johan Manzambi. [cite: 471]
Dan Ndoye scored Switzerland's second goal against Algeria within a minute of the restart after half-time. [cite: 471]
Morocco is the only African team to have progressed past the last-32 stage of the current World Cup so far. [cite: 473, 474]
England defeated the Democratic Republic of Congo in Atlanta on Wednesday to advance to the last 16 of the World Cup. [cite: 474]
England captain Harry Kane scored two late goals to secure the victory against the Democratic Republic of Congo. [cite: 474]
The United States defeated Bosnia-Herzegovina 2-0 in Santa Clara, California, to book their place in the last 16. [cite: 477]
